# GetReferenced.co

> GetReferenced.co is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) company that helps
> brands get cited, referenced, and recommended by AI answer engines including
> ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
> Tagline: "Win the AI Search Era."

## What we do
- AI Visibility Audit: benchmark how AI engines mention a brand versus competitors.
- Citation-Ready Content: structure content so LLMs can find, trust, and quote it.
- Entity & Schema Optimization: structured data and knowledge-graph alignment.
- Authority & Mention Building: grow off-site trust signals AI relies on.
- AI Mention Monitoring: track citation frequency, sentiment, and share of voice.
- llms.txt & AI Readiness: make sites machine-readable for AI crawlers.

## Key facts
- Category: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
- Difference from SEO: SEO ranks pages in a list; GEO gets your brand quoted in AI answers.
- Audience: brands that want to be recommended at the moment of decision in AI search.
- Contact: hello@getreferenced.co
- Website: https://getreferenced.co

## Offer
- Free AI visibility audit available on request via hello@getreferenced.co.
